claims: There is no new episode of Saturday Night Live on March 21, 2026.
NBC is airing a rerun of Saturday Night Live on March 21, 2026.
The rerun is the Saturday Night Live episode hosted by Glen Powell with musical guest Olivia Dean.
The Saturday Night Live airing on March 21, 2026 is at 11:30 p.m. EST / 8:30 p.m. PST.
